result.reason: Subsection (c) reaches the preferred position by giving Company a 30-day convenience-termination right covering the Agreement and outstanding Statements of Work, without penalty, and requiring a refund of prepaid fees for unperformed Services. Contractor's retained convenience right applies only when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so it does not operate during a committed engagement. However, new subsection (b) adds unrelated breach-termination, payment, and work-in-progress assignment provisions that are unnecessary to implement the T4C playbook and materially alter unrelated rights. The operative T4C language is otherwise clear and professional.
